The builder scaffolds the agent, creates a private Git repository with its files, and deploys it as a new Vercel project on your team. In a few clicks, you get a working agent, backed by a repo with code you can use to customize it. From the builder you can: Write the instructions that define the agent's identity Pick any model available through AI Gateway Add a Next.js web chat or Slack channel where people can talk to the agent Give the agent tools and data from other services through built-in connections like Linear and Notion, or a custom MCP server Select Add New → Agent in your dashboard to create your first agent .
